name: ferrata_updater_module
description: Ferrata (prototype): ferrata-updater as a module: keeps Ferrata light-client instances on LEZ following Ethereum from several beacon API sources, verifies every candidate with the program's own steps before paying for it, and drives the attestation program's public job; with the in-process LEZ v0.4.0-rc1 chain of its tests (the sequencer backend is not built)
